firm_data.firm_description: Rupp Pfalzgraf LLC, established in 2000, is a full-service law firm headquartered in Buffalo, NY. The firm employs more than 70 attorneys across seven offices throughout New York State.
notable_facts: Recognized by Best Lawyers of America, Super Lawyers, Business First's Legal Elite, and Business First's 40 Under 40 and 30 Under 30.
Honoured for unique culture, including recognition by Business First as a Most Admired Company, and more than 16 times as one of Western New York's Best Places to Work.

ai_contact.ai_notes: Rupp Pfalzgraf launched an AI Law, Compliance & Emerging Technology practice to help organizations navigate the quickly evolving landscape of AI.
